```python
import narwhals as nw

def top_sales(df):
    nw_df = nw.from_native(df)
    filtered = nw_df.filter(nw.col("amount") > 100)
    sorted_df = filtered.sort("amount", descending=True)
    return sorted_df.to_native()
```
